title: Agora restart persistence probe cannot import services since 2026-09-15

regression_resolved.description: Deployment step 'Dev Agora restart persistence smoke under lease' failed deterministically since 2026-09-15: smoke script runs inside the container by absolute path with cleared PYTHONPATH, having only scripts/ and BFF_ROOT on sys.path. Commit 7b8f8ad3f added imports from services.research to agora.strategy_workshop.reconstruction, causing ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'services'. Furthermore, existing test test_standalone_cli_imports_without_repository_pythonpath was never executed by Branch CI Gate.
regression_resolved.resolution: Configured scripts/agora_workshop_restart_persistence_smoke.py to prepend both BFF_ROOT and ROOT to sys.path with BFF_ROOT having precedence so agora resolves to the deployed container modules and services resolves to repository services. Added scripts/test_agora_workshop_restart_persistence_smoke.py to Branch CI Gate under 'Run delivery diagnostics and exit-status regressions' alongside the other deploy helpers. Added explicit regression tests proving standalone CLI execution with cleared PYTHONPATH, resolution of agora to deployed container modules, and execution in Branch CI.

owned: scripts/agora_workshop_restart_persistence_smoke.py: configure sys.path with BFF_ROOT at index 0 and ROOT at index 1
scripts/test_agora_workshop_restart_persistence_smoke.py: regression tests for standalone execution without PYTHONPATH, deployed container agora resolution, and branch-ci execution
not_changing: No production imports or modules in services/ were widened or modified
No change to deployed container Dockerfiles or compose contracts
No change to auto-integrator or governance state machine

criterion_1.statement: the probe imports and runs when executed by absolute path with PYTHONPATH cleared and the working directory outside the repository
criterion_1.evidence: Verified by test_standalone_cli_imports_without_repository_pythonpath and manual execution from /tmp with PYTHONPATH cleared: python /path/to/scripts/agora_workshop_restart_persistence_smoke.py --help exits 0 with usage output.

criterion_2.statement: the agora package still resolves to the modules the deployed container serves rather than any other copy
criterion_2.evidence: Verified by test_agora_package_resolves_to_deployed_bff_modules: agora.__file__ resolves strictly to services/control-plane/bff/agora/__init__.py and not services/agora.

criterion_3.statement: the existing standalone import regression test passes and is executed by the branch gate that already guards the other deploy helpers
criterion_3.evidence: Verified by test_branch_ci_gate_executes_persistence_smoke_test and branch-ci.yml: scripts/test_agora_workshop_restart_persistence_smoke.py is included in 'Run delivery diagnostics and exit-status regressions' which guards the other deploy helpers when delivery is touched.

criterion_4.statement: no production import is widened beyond what the probe itself needs
criterion_4.evidence: No files in services/ were modified; sys.path adjustment is confined strictly to the standalone CLI probe helper scripts/agora_workshop_restart_persistence_smoke.py.

results: Standalone CLI invocation from /tmp with PYTHONPATH cleared exited 0 with usage output
